restraints_config._comment: rgi_utils restraint-guided inference (distance + ligand conformer). RUN: protenix pred -i restr_example.json -o out --use_default_params true --use_msa false --seeds 0 --step 200 --sample 1 --cycle 4 . Keys: gpu = torch device (true=GPU, false=CPU); method=CG; max_iter per step. start_sigma: a restraint is ACTIVE only when sigma<=start_sigma; OPTIONAL per distance entry and once in conformer_restraints_config (omit -> active every step; set e.g. 1.0 for late-only); no top-level/global start_sigma. RMSD restraint: rmsd_restraints_config below (REQUIRES a reference PDB — generate it first). ('_comment' keys are ignored by the parser.)

distance_restraints_config._comment: COM distance between two atom groups, pulled to target_distance. type options: harmonic{target_distance} | flat-bottomed{target_distance1,target_distance2} | flat-bottomed1{target_distance1} | flat-bottomed2{target_distance2}. Selection DSL: chain/resid N/resid A to B/index/and/or/not/(). resid = per-chain 1-based ordinal; QUALIFY protein groups with 'chain A and (...)' so a bare resid range does not also match the ligand (chain B) atoms.
distance_restraints_config.atom_selection1: chain A and ((resid 5 to 84) or (resid 186 to 224))
distance_restraints_config._stop_sigma: optional lower bound, default -1 (off); release the restraint below this sigma (window stop<=sigma<=start). Rename '_stop_sigma' -> 'stop_sigma' to enable

conformer_restraints_config._comment: Hold the GLN ligand at its ideal RDKit geometry (bond/angle/chiral + intramolecular VdW; GLN has one stereocentre at CA). dihedral = cis/trans (E/Z) of an acyclic non-aromatic double bond: GLN has none (terminal C=O) so dihedrals=0 here, but all 7 tools detect them when present (e.g. fumarate/maleate). start_sigma here applies to ALL conformer terms (one value, all ligands); lower it (e.g. 1.0) to enforce ligand geometry only late in denoising.
conformer_restraints_config._stop_sigma: optional lower bound for ALL conformer terms, default -1 (off); release below this sigma. Rename '_stop_sigma' -> 'stop_sigma' to enable

rmsd_restraints_config._comment: RMSD restraint. Kabsch-superposed RMSD of a moving group toward target_rmsd vs a reference PDB. Generate ref_pdb first: a vanilla prediction of this sequence converted to PDB (gemmi make_pdb_string). Atoms pair by IDENTITY (chain, resid, atom-name), so the ref atom order need not match. ALL options are shown below; keys starting with '_' are IGNORED by the parser (JSON has no comments, so '_<name>' = a commented-out variable -- rename to '<name>' to enable it).
rmsd_restraints_config._start_sigma: optional, e.g. 99999999; omit -> active every step (1.0 = late only)
rmsd_restraints_config._stop_sigma: optional LOWER bound, default -1 (off). RELEASE the restraint below this sigma (window stop<=sigma<=start) so the model re-idealises geometry it held distorted -- fixes a broken peptide bond at a restrained-residue / free unmodeled-tail boundary; 1.0 validated for this whole-structure target_rmsd=0 case
rmsd_restraints_config._pairing: 'identity' (default: pair by chain/resid/atom-name) | 'align' (HOMOLOG ref: BLOSUM62 sequence-align, tolerates substitutions/indels/renumbering). NOTE align pairs backbone + ANY shared side-chain atom names by default, pinning a substituted residue's side chain onto the ref's coords; add a 'name CA' atom_selection to superpose backbone only
rmsd_restraints_config._best_effort: true (default: skip atoms unmatched in the ref) | false (strict: raise on any unmatched atom)
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_ref: optional; omit -> WHOLE structure. Shorthand ref side (sets BOTH fit & calc), e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)'
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_target: shorthand target side, e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)'
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_ref_fit: OR split: atoms superposed (ref), e.g. 'chain A and (resid 5 to 220)'
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_ref_calc: atoms measured (ref), e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)'
